message:
I couldn't run a sanity test (`python3 -c ...`) — the sandbox auto-denied it since there's no approval surface in this session. The implementation itself is done, though.

Filled the gap in `slug.py` using only stdlib (`re`, `unicodedata`), no new functions/classes, no renames — respecting the default locks:

```python
ascii_only = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", ascii_only.lower()).strip("-")
return slug[:max_length].rstrip("-")
```

NFKD normalization + ASCII encode/ignore strips accents (é → e), regex collapses non-alphanumeric runs into single `-` and trims edges, then truncates to `max_length` with a trailing `-` cleanup in case truncation lands mid-separator.
